overview: One early summer morning, Gustav wakes up in the same little cottage on Hälsö. Today, just like most other days, he’s getting ready to head out onto the waves. The summer evenings are still cold, yet his friends gather down at the harbor on the weekends. Day by day, the buzz grows louder about apartments in Gothenburg and university studies awaiting them after the summer. But all Gustav can think about is the girl he keeps passing, time and time again, on his way to the boat. What Gustav doesn't yet know is that he isn't the only one in his group of friends who has taken a liking to this mysterious girl. Slowly, a rift begins to form, putting more than just friendship to the test.
title: Hälsö
